children: US drive-thru coffee chain's Q3 revenue rose 30% yr/yr as 11 new stores opened
Same-store sales grew 5.8% yr/yr, marking 15th straight quarter of positive growth
Company returned to profitability with net income of $2.7 mln in Q3
Company raises full-year 2026 new store openings target to 40
Company sees full-year 2026 revenue between $255 mln and $257 mln
Company expects full-year 2026 adjusted EBITDA of $34 mln to $35 mln
STORE EXPANSION - Co said opening 11 new stores in Q3 contributed to revenue growth
SAME-STORE SALES - Co cited 5.8% same-store sales growth and positive transaction growth as drivers of results
MENU AND LOYALTY INITIATIVES - Co said menu innovation, longer hours, and enhanced loyalty program supported customer engagement
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 4 "strong buy" or "buy", 4 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the restaurants & bars peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Black Rock Coffee Bar, Inc. is $11.00, about 0.9% below its November 9 closing price of $11.10
